CULTURAL HERITAGE COMMISSION AGENDA
  TUESDAY, AUGUST 26, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 5:00 PM

Kevin McGuan, Chair  Jacqueline Padilla-Perez, Commissioner
Mark Grisafe, Vice Chair  Marco Pizzo, Commissioner
Amy Bodek, Commissioner  Jocelynn Pryor, Commissioner
Tasha Hunter, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING

  CULTURAL HERITAGE COMMISSION IN-PERSON MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS
  TO CULTURAL.HERITAGE@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION OR BY PRESSING *9 ON YOUR PHONE

  PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 982 3985 6018
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/98239856018

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56220  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56221  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Cultural Heritage Commission
  meeting of Tuesday, July 29, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56222  Recommendation to review the landmark nomination, background materials, make
  all appropriate findings and make a recommendation to City Council to designate
  the property located at 3917 Country Club Drive in the Single-Family Residential

   CULTURAL HERITAGE COMMISSION AGENDA
  TUESDAY, AUGUST 26, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 5:00 PM

  zone (R-1-L) as a Locally Designated Historic Landmark building. (District 5)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-56223  Recommendation to approve a Certificate of Appropriateness and adopt the
  proposed findings and conditions of approval thereto, for construction of a one-
  story 900-square-foot addition to the rear of an existing 988-square-foot single-
  family residence, and construction of a new attached 507-square-foot two (2) car
  garage at the rear of property. The project site is located at 4125 East 6th Street,
  within the Single-family Residential, standard lot (R-1-N) and is a Contributing
  Structure within the Belmont Heights Historic District. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-56224  Recommendation to consider Mills Act contracts for four properties, 3725 Lime
  Avenue, 3596 Gundry Avenue, 2742 East 4th Street, and 3733 and 3733 A
  California Avenue not originally forwarded by staff for consideration (Districts 1, 2,
  3, 5, 7)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Cultural Heritage Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
